lead: A Minnehaha County city five miles east of Sioux Falls, along the Big Sioux River and Split Rock Creek.
living:
Brandon is in Minnehaha County, about five miles east of Sioux Falls, where the Big Sioux River and Split Rock Creek meet the edge of town. The Census counted 11,048 people here in 2020, making it one of the larger cities around Sioux Falls.

Brandon grew mostly from the 1970s on, so you'll find a mix of homes from several decades, from established streets to newer subdivisions on the edges of town.
know: What to know before you buy in Brandon

• Getting around: I-90 runs along the north side of town, and Brandon connects to the east side of Sioux Falls.
  • Outdoor space: the Big Sioux Recreation Area is right next to town, and a bike path connects to it.
  • Older and newer homes: for homes from the 1970s–90s, plan for an inspection that looks closely at the roof, windows and mechanicals.
  • Property taxes: Brandon is in Minnehaha County, and the Brandon Valley School District levy is part of the bill.
schools: Brandon is served by the Brandon Valley School District. Always confirm the school district for a specific address.
faq:
What county is Brandon in?

Brandon is in Minnehaha County. Property taxes are set by Minnehaha County, the city and the local school district.

What school district serves Brandon?

Brandon is served by the Brandon Valley School District. Always confirm the district for a specific address.

How far is Brandon from Sioux Falls?

Brandon is about five miles east of Sioux Falls, with I-90 along the north side of town.

Can I get down payment help to buy in Brandon?

Often, yes. South Dakota Housing programs, including Give Me Five, can be used for homes in Brandon if you and the home qualify. Income and price limits apply. See the down payment help options.
